# AgentRules

These files are synced automatically from
[TucanoAgentRules](https://github.com/TucanoTechnology/TucanoAgentRules).

**Do not edit files in this directory directly.** Changes made here are
overwritten by the next sync. Submit changes against the source repository
instead; they will arrive here as an automated pull request.

Rules that are specific to this repository belong in its own `AGENTS.md`, not
in this directory.
